name: All in One SEO
summary: WordPress SEO plugin for titles, schema, sitemaps and redirects.
best_for: WordPress site owners and agencies who want titles, schema, sitemaps and redirects in one plugin and accept yearly licences
skip_if: your site is not on WordPress, you want a free plugin version on this page, or you want a tool we have tested end to end
honest_knock: The first-year price is half the regular price and every renewal is at full price. The pricing page stated USD but showed euro amounts when we read it. Renewals are non-refundable. We did not test it.

pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-14 on aioseo.com/pricing) All in One SEO sells four yearly plans. Basic covers 1 site with 10,000 AI credits and lists smart schema markup, WooCommerce SEO and XML sitemaps; it is shown at 49.50 for the first year and regular at 99. Plus covers 3 sites with 25,000 AI credits and adds local SEO; shown at 99.50, regular 199. Pro covers 10 sites with 50,000 AI credits and adds the internal link assistant and advanced redirects; shown at 199.50, regular 399. Elite covers 100 sites with 200,000 AI credits and adds keyword rank tracking and client management; shown at 299.50, regular 599. The page says all pricing is in USD but displayed euro amounts when we read it, so confirm the currency at checkout. All renewals are at full price. There is a 14-day money-back guarantee, renewals are non-refundable, and AI credits are refundable within 14 days if fewer than 500 were used. The page mentions no free version of the plugin.
